name: explaining
description: Build an explanation of how a protocol, a system, or a process works around one running example, with a numbered map of the stages, pairs of similar things told apart, misreadings ruled out, every combination of conditions with its result, moving figures where order or conditions matter, and a closing table with one sentence to take away, and provide that structure to other skills through musubi

interface.longDescription: Writes an explanation of how a protocol, a system, a process, or a piece of research works that a reader new to the subject can follow. One concrete example runs through every section. A numbered map of the stages comes first, and each later section digs into one stage. Similar things are told apart in a table, likely misreadings are ruled out where they arise, every combination of conditions is laid out with its result, and a table of roles with one sentence to take away closes it. Where order, a change of state, or conditions matter, it asks for a figure that steps, takes input, or shows the state before and after. Other skills can follow the same structure through musubi. It is instruction files only and runs nothing.
defaultPrompt: Explain how a payment is confirmed across three servers
